note: FrieslandCampina; 57 % of infant formulas launched in 2025 contained GOS (NutraIngredients 2025)

about.text: The galacto-oligosaccharide ingredient of FrieslandCampina, made from lactose by an enzyme and added to infant formula and other foods to feed gut bifidobacteria.
